passages.text: Before moving to a new town, I tell my friend that I will write after my first school week. I want to keep a promise, even though the new timetable takes time to get used to. On Friday evening, I write about my classroom, my route to school and one kind person I met. We agree to keep in touch with each other through letters and occasional messages. My friend replies with news of our old club and asks a question about my new school. The exchange helps us remain part of each other’s lives even when our everyday places are different.

parallelText.en: Before moving to a new town, I tell my friend that I will write after my first school week.
parallelText.zh: 搬去新城镇前，我告诉朋友，第一周上学结束后会给他写信。

parallelText.en: I want to keep a promise, even though the new timetable takes time to get used to.
parallelText.zh: 虽然需要时间适应新课表，我还是想遵守诺言。

parallelText.en: On Friday evening, I write about my classroom, my route to school and one kind person I met.
parallelText.zh: 周五晚上，我写下教室、上学路线和遇到的一位友好的人。

parallelText.en: We agree to keep in touch with each other through letters and occasional messages.
parallelText.zh: 我们约定通过书信和偶尔的信息保持联系。

parallelText.en: My friend replies with news of our old club and asks a question about my new school.
parallelText.zh: 朋友回复旧社团的近况，并问了一个关于新学校的问题。

parallelText.en: The exchange helps us remain part of each other’s lives even when our everyday places are different.
parallelText.zh: 虽然日常生活地点不同，这样交流仍让我们参与彼此的生活。

wordHelp.meaning: giving and receiving messages or information

passages.text: During rehearsal, a pupil forgets a line and pauses in front of the group. Two others begin to laugh at him, and he becomes too embarrassed to continue. The group leader stops the rehearsal and reminds everyone that mistakes are part of practice. “How about trying the scene in pairs first?” she suggests. The pupils agree, apologise and work with partners before returning to the full group. With a calmer start and helpful listeners, the pupil says the line clearly on his next try.

parallelText.en: During rehearsal, a pupil forgets a line and pauses in front of the group.
parallelText.zh: 排练时，一位学生忘了台词，在大家面前停了下来。

parallelText.en: Two others begin to laugh at him, and he becomes too embarrassed to continue.
parallelText.zh: 另外两人开始嘲笑他，他尴尬得无法继续。

parallelText.en: The group leader stops the rehearsal and reminds everyone that mistakes are part of practice.
parallelText.zh: 小组负责人暂停排练，提醒大家错误是练习的一部分。

parallelText.en: “How about trying the scene in pairs first?” she suggests.
parallelText.zh: 她建议：“先两人一组试演这一幕怎么样？”

parallelText.en: The pupils agree, apologise and work with partners before returning to the full group.
parallelText.zh: 学生们同意，作了道歉，并先与搭档练习，再回到全组排练。

parallelText.en: With a calmer start and helpful listeners, the pupil says the line clearly on his next try.
parallelText.zh: 有了更平静的开始和愿意帮助的听众，那位学生下次清楚说出了台词。
